name: @itpay/cli
stderr:
Usage: itpay [options] [command]

V3 ItPay CLI — buy services, review orders, and read human-authorized purchased
content

Options:
  --agent-type <type>         agent runtime type used for device enrollment and
                              client-specific guidance
  -V, --version               output the version number
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  readyz [options]            Probe the V3 backend readiness endpoint
  device                      Recover the current official Backend registration
                              after an operator-confirmed reset
  skill                       Read complete packaged Agent skills
  next [options]              Show the next recommended agent action from
                              remembered server handles
  catalog                     Browse V3 service catalog
  install [options] [target]  Show agent-specific installation and
                              configuration instructions
  docs                        Browse agent documentation
  cart                        V3 canonical server cart
  buy [options]               Create a V3 cart and checkout, then render the
                              checkout QR for the host
  checkout [options]          Read the canonical V3 checkout presentation by
                              checkout_id + display_token
  pay [options]               Create a V3 payment intent (CLI escape hatch —
                              usually done by the checkout page)
  order [options] <order_id>  Read a V3 order by id
  orders [options]            List safe order summaries for the current
                              authorized account
  feedback                    Rate one service item from an existing order
  refund [options]            Create a V3 refund request for an order
  vault                       Find and read previously purchased content with
                              human authorization
  services                    Generic V3 Service Execution commands
  help [command]              display help for command

Agent quick start:
  1. Run: itpay install --json
  2. Select the real Agent Type and execute each returned next.command unchanged.
  3. Read the packaged Skill, then route the human's natural-language intent.

Common human intents:
  New service or query       catalog list
  Previously purchased item vault list
  Purchase history           orders
  Delivery or refund problem resume the known Order or Refund
  Review a completed service feedback submit

The Agent runs commands. Ask the human only to choose, authorize, pay, provide
required contact details, or confirm a refund. Never expose commands or internal IDs.
